message.content:
This document is a technical README and set of engineering notes for **Project Maya**, a local inference engine for running very large open-weight models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) on consumer and workstation hardware. Key technical points:

**Models and quantization**
- Maya quants are tiered by expert bit-width (XS/S/M/L) and named by setup id (e.g. `glm-maya-s24`). GLM-5.3-Flash Maya quants retain 97.7–99
